subject: physics
content: Two Carnot engines A and B operate in series such that engine A absorbs heat at T<sub>1</sub> and rejects heat to a sink at temperature T. Engine B absorbs half of the heat rejected by Engine A and rejects heat to the sink at T<sub>3</sub>. When workdone in both the cases is equal, to value of T is :
